assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's single curated item, reviewed-dedicated-analysis: the canonical V2 character reconstruction model MHA_SP2_ALL_FOR_ONE_CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MODEL.md at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the Japanese main manga V01-V42 with the source-labeled Ultra Archive, Ultra Analysis and Ultra Age claims its AF-SUP-01 to AF-SUP-03 sections admit. The MHA character modeling schema was consulted for method only; the readiness index, supplemental reconciliation ledger and audit and the deep readings are not curated evidence on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them. The model's strong label and its retrospective holdout probe are inputs, not conclusions. No original manga page, anime adaptation, V1 material or other character's model is included, and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: All For One from the V40:p137-149 and p151-160 retrospective narration of birth, childhood, early extraction, the chosen Demon Lord ideal and the refusal of Yoichi's exit, through the V13:p142-148 and V25:p025-034 planner and teacher who shelters and names Tenko, the V28:p047-058, V30:p183-187 and V31:p035-037 transfer into and operation of the successor's body, the V35:p023-039, p059-075, p171-187 and V36:p057-103 adaptive campaign, the V38 Rewind state and V39:p141-179 confrontation with All Might, and the V40:p178-191 dysregulation and external disappearance, to the V41:p129-140, p166-171 and V42:p008-015 vestige claims and terminal plea to Yoichi. Kept as separable states: early acquisition and the Yoichi relation, long-term planner and teacher, wounded external body, Rewind-dysregulated body, vestige or controller, and terminal need; the V40-V42 origin and attachment revelations are reader-time later than V38-V39 and are excluded from the AF-V01 freeze. No atom covers V01-V12, V14-V24, V26-V27, V29, V32-V34 or V37.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model states a governing aspiration (a world organized around him, with resources, narratives and people as means or possessions), an ideal Demon Lord self, a feared thwarted or irrelevant self, and the normative belief that giving power is title to command, grounded in located atoms AF01-AF07; it separates his belief from the analyst's judgment, and the probe AF-V01 rates motive partial. Not B: one artifact, one retrospective nonblind probe, and AF-SUP-02 leaves an editorial claim that emotions did not form unresolved against the granular attachment evidence. Not D: the model is operational, with conditional triggers and stated confidence.

Six named states are distinguished (early acquisition and Yoichi, planner and teacher, wounded external body, Rewind-dysregulated body, vestige or controller, terminal need) and located from V13 to V42; the model separates original and duplicate factors and denies that Rewind returns an ideal younger self (AF02, AF06, AF-SUP-03). Not B: the early and centuries-long planner states are known mainly through V40 retrospective narration and two V13 and V25 windows. Not D: transitions are located and the knowledge differences between states are stated.

The model identifies 僕, calm explanatory syntax, seemingly permissive instruction and intimate naming as carriers of coercion, and escalation into emphatic possessives, repetition and cries under terminal loss, locating requests that remain denials of exit at V40:p149 and V42:p014-015; the probe rates speech/register supported. Not C: no located lines are quoted and ordinary register outside strategic or terminal settings is unsampled. Not E: a recurrent register with conditioned variants is identified and tested on one axis. The discovery row does not enroll SPEECH.

The evidence set locates no ordinary conduct: the model says ordinary hospitality, romance and harmless leisure decisions are low-confidence or unsupported and that a harmless dinner with a genuine equal cannot be reconstructed confidently. The name provenance in AF-SUP-01 is identity, not routine. This gap says nothing about the character.

A five-row partner table gives conditional deltas for Yoichi, Tomura and Tenko, All Might and Kudo-associated figures, Garaki and subordinates, and Spinner, Aoyama and other vulnerable intermediaries, located in AF01, AF03-AF05 and AF07; All Might's exceptional salience is tested by the probe, which rates relationship handling supported in the adversarial domain. Not B: every sampled relation is asymmetric, coercive or adversarial, and the model states that reciprocal ordinary relations are untested. Not D: several partners have located, conditioned deltas.

Located interior windows are the V40 narration of childhood deprivation and chosen aspiration (AF05), the V40 dysregulation that weakens factor integration (AF06), and the terminal plea (AF07); the model reads calm as regulation rather than absence of feeling. Not C: interior is inferred mainly from conduct and narration, and the editorial affect theory and the love-or-domination question (AF-SUP-02) are recorded as unresolved rather than settled. Not E: several located windows bear on inner state.

The decision policy is explicit: preserve options, engineer the environment, offer a seemingly voluntary route and convert acceptance into control; on failure replace a body, change mechanism or intensify coercion; under All Might, Yoichi or Kudo-linked threat and bodily dysregulation, affect can override the long game (AF02-AF06). The probe rates action supported conditionally. B was considered for this, his best-sampled domain, and rejected: one artifact and one retrospective nonblind probe, and the model says plans are neither omniscient nor immune to architecture-specific failure. Not D: the policy is explicit, repeated and located.

The model states his normative policy (power given is a title to command; loss of control is experienced as theft even when another simply leaves) and locates its enactment in the refusal of Yoichi's exit and the terminal plea (AF05, AF07). Not C: no located episode shows him weighing competing moral considerations; the evidence describes a stance, not deliberation. Not E: the stance is explicit, located and separated from the analyst's judgment. The discovery row does not enroll ETHICS.
The model analyzes no humor or play; indulgently pedagogical presentation is described as control. This gap says nothing about the character.

The project's analytical corpus is complete for V01-V42 and the admitted supplements; seven atoms span V13-V42 with page locators, and the V39 and V41-V42 pages were checked in Japanese. Long intervals are unsampled, the early states are retrospective, V40:p150 is excluded as authorial material, and the supplements are profile facts, an author comment and editorial summaries, one of them in unresolved conflict.

Affirmative limits are located: the model REVISEs affectlessness (AF06) and invulnerable foresight (AF03, defeat by a speaker-intent blind spot), REJECTs total authorship as fact, citing Tomura's independent League relation and resistance as counterevidence, and love as moral amnesty (AF07), records Rewind as an administered effect he cannot control and a final attack that injures himself (AF-SUP-03), and denies him conscious memory of his name's provenance (AF-SUP-01). Not B: the limits rest on few windows in one artifact.

Atoms are page-located with the V31 page convention stated, Japanese pages are checked for V39 and V41-V42, the frozen probe excludes V39 tactics and the V40-V42 revelations from its V38 inputs, and body, factor and control states are separated. Not B: in-world dates are not given and the long early chronology is compressed into retrospective narration.

scenario_readiness.note: The model quotes no located lines and states that generated dialogue would be an illustrative prediction, never an attributed quotation; it warns against both the shouting tyrant and reading a polite sentence as noncoercive. Lines beyond the described register would be fluent invention. This bounds the evidence set, not All For One's actual speech.

conditions: Chronology is one named state, stated explicitly: early acquisition, regulated planner and teacher, wounded external body, Rewind-dysregulated body, vestige or controller, or terminal need; Rewind is not treated as a costless return to youth and later revelations are not given to earlier states.

Before simulation, body, factor availability, rival location, remaining time, what surveillance has actually revealed and which personal grievance is activated are specified, as the model requires; he does not know private conversations or future acts.

The interlocutor stands in one of the asymmetric relations the partner table gives (Yoichi, Tomura or Tenko, All Might or Kudo-associated figures, Garaki or subordinates, a vulnerable intermediary, or a recruit); no genuine equal, harmless social encounter or invented reciprocal friendship.
Output is a behavioral description with alternatives that keeps knowing a trap distinct from declining it, no quoted dialogue is produced as canon and no readiness is inherited from the strong label.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named state: early acquisition, regulated planner and teacher, wounded body, Rewind-dysregulated body, vestige or controller, or terminal need, stated explicitly.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Yoichi, Tomura or Tenko, All Might or Kudo-associated figures, Garaki or subordinates, a vulnerable intermediary, or a useful recruit, in the asymmetric relation the partner table gives.
setting_constraints: Strategic, coercive, recruiting or adversarial confrontation
Body, factor, time and surveillance limits specified and respected
No ordinary hospitality, leisure, romantic or reciprocal-equal setting

scenario_readiness.note: The model's stated hypothetical (regulated planner AFO with a useful recruit who accepts help while insisting on an independent future: appear permissive while shaping dependence, test attachments, keep a replacement option, medium-high confidence; a Yoichi or OFA opportunity or severe time limit may produce overt coercion) and the probe's conditionally supported recognized-bait result support narrow novel scenes. The probe is retrospective, nonblind and partial on motive.

The model states that a harmless dinner conversation with a genuine equal cannot be reconstructed confidently and that no relaxed reciprocal friendship or healthy family mode can be supplied; it warns against filling the gap with a charming-villain stereotype.

His normative stance is explicit and located (AF05, AF07), but no located episode shows him deliberating between competing moral considerations; predicting his ownership claim is a conflict-behavior and cross-scenario question, not simulation of moral deliberation.
The model calls romance low-confidence or unsupported; the evidence set establishes neither romantic conduct nor its absence. That limits inference; it says nothing about the character.

conditions: The setting is his strategic or organizational project: teaching and directing Tomura, technical collaboration with Garaki, delegated operations, or recruitment of an intermediary, with the state named.
Output preserves option preservation, engineered conditions, asymmetric delegation and replacement routes, and does not infer equality from a collaborator's competence.
Planning is adaptive but not omniscient; architecture-specific failures and unavailable surveillance remain possible.
scenario_readiness.note: Organizational conduct is located in the planner and teacher state (AF01), the vessel and replacement planning (AF02-AF03) and the partner table's Garaki and subordinates row.

known_limits.statement: Under Rewind and All Might's challenge he spends time on All Might despite recognizing delay as the opponent's purpose; knowing a trap does not entail declining it (AF04, AF-V01).
His plans are adaptive but not omniscient: a speaker-intent blind spot defeats one channel (AF03), and he does not know every private conversation or future act.
Calm is regulation rather than absence of feeling; dysregulation under the younger body weakens factor integration (AF06), and affectlessness is REVISEd.
His claim to have authored everything about Tomura is a totalizing ownership claim, not narrator certification; Tomura's independent League relation and resistance are counterevidence (AF07).
His attachment to Yoichi is real and possessive; need does not become recognition of the brother's right to leave, and love is not moral amnesty (AF05, AF07).

Original and duplicate factors, wounded senses, Rewind, the internal vestige and external survival are distinct systems; Rewind is administered and uncontrollable, and his final stockpiled attack injures himself (AF02, AF06, AF-SUP-03).
The name Shigaraki Zen and its provenance give him no conscious autobiographical memory of its history (AF-SUP-01).

An editorial claim that his emotions did not form, with a tentative cause, stands in unresolved tension with observed attachment, rage and control failure; neither it nor a love label establishes emptiness, a diagnosis or reciprocity (AF-SUP-02).
Supplement profile facts, the author comment and editorial summaries (AF-SUP-01 to AF-SUP-03) constrain reconstruction without becoming enacted manga observations.

The single formal probe AF-V01 is a retrospective chronological evidence holdout by an analyst who had read later manga, not a blind experiment; motive was partial and exact equipment and time loss were not predictable.

The model marks ordinary reciprocal conduct OPEN because no broad sample exists; the evidence set cannot say how he behaves with a genuine equal or in harmless leisure. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
No atom covers V01-V12, V14-V24, V26-V27, V29, V32-V34 or V37, so behavior over those intervals is not established by this evidence set.

The deep readings, readiness index, supplemental reconciliation ledger and audit linked from the model are not curated evidence on this subject, so their warrants were not independently rechecked here. Anime performance and any supplement material beyond what the model cites lie outside this evidence set.
